title: Which Starship Crew Role Are You?
description: The galaxy needs you — but where on the bridge do you belong? Find your post among the stars.

questions.text: Your alarm goes off an hour early by mistake. You:

answers.text: Get up anyway — the day just got longer, use it
Roll out smoothly — you can be ready in four minutes
First check that it didn't wake anyone else
Investigate why it happened before anything else

questions.text: Your friends are planning a road trip. You're the one who:

answers.text: Decides the destination when the debate stalls
Quietly checks the tires and oil before anyone asks
Insists on taking the fun winding route
Builds a spreadsheet of stops nobody asked for

questions.text: You win a prize — pick one experience:

answers.text: A workshop where you build something you keep
Skydiving
A spa weekend for someone who deserves it
A behind-the-scenes laboratory tour
Assign puzzles so nobody doubles up
Take the padlock apart. It's faster.
Trust the gut guess before the clock runs out
Keep morale up when the countdown gets scary
Direct foot traffic around them while others help
Fashion a new bag out of whatever's handy
Drop everything and start gathering oranges
Wonder briefly about bag design flaws — while helping

questions.text: A stranger's grocery bag rips open on the sidewalk. You:
Pick the compliment you'd most like to receive:

answers.text: 'I'd follow you anywhere'
'You make hard things look easy'
'You always know exactly what I need'
'I never thought of it that way'
Strategy — you play the long game
Anything where you get to build things
Racing — pure reflexes
Puzzles and mysteries

questions.text: Something breaks at the worst possible moment. Your instinct:

answers.text: Grab it. You can probably fix it.
Improvise around it and keep moving
Make sure no one's hurt first
Ask what caused it before touching anything
A tough decision needs a tiebreaker
Something's rattling and they don't know why
They need someone up for anything, right now
They've had the worst day and need to talk

questions.text: You get one sentence on a billboard. It says:

answers.text: 'Someone has to decide. Might as well be you.'
'It's not broken forever.'
'Have you eaten today? Eat something.'
'Look closer.'
An itinerary with clear priorities — and backup plans
Book the flight, figure out the rest on landing
Slow mornings, everyone well-fed and happy
Museums until your feet give out
Take charge: water check, daylight check, decision
Rig trail markers so it can't happen twice
Climb something tall and get your bearings by feel
Recall the trail map from memory — mostly

questions.text: The group gets turned around on a hike. You:

results.description: You carry the weight so others don't have to. Decisive and steady, you make the hard calls and own the outcomes — and your crew would follow you into any storm.
Nothing stays broken around you. Practical, patient, and endlessly resourceful, you keep everything running while making it look easy. The ship flies because of you.
The heart of the crew. You notice who's struggling before they say a word, and you hold everyone together when things get rough. Every mission needs you most.
Cool head, quick hands, zero panic. You trust your instincts because they've earned it, and you make the impossible maneuver look routine. Buckle up, everyone.
Powered by pure wonder. You ask the questions nobody thought of and find the answers nobody expected. Every strange new world is your favorite place.
